subject.kind: a Claude Code skill: SKILL.md, playbooks, scripts and a page template
subject.purpose: grade any target into an HTML report card: find its subject, derive a rubric, grade it with evidence, show the page (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1046)
subject.reader: the owner, who reads the report card, and the agents that run the skill; a wrong or unreadable card sends the owner to fix the wrong thing
frameworks: research on rubric grading and report design, cited in references/report.md

folder-named-card.evidence: Command: grep -m1 '^name:' card/SKILL.md -> 'name: card'; ls -d skills/*/ -> 'card/' only, no rubric folder.
folder-named-card.why: Name is card and no rubric sibling exists.

step-profile-subject.evidence: "**Subject**: read the target and write its kind, purpose and reader, each with a quote or path that shows it"
step-profile-subject.why: Step 1 names all three facts and precedes the Rubric step.

step-derive-rubric.evidence: "**Rubric**: write the spec as author.md says, drawing criteria from the frameworks and the target's own stated purpose... The subject fills task.world and evidence_goal."
step-derive-rubric.why: Derive step takes the subject as input and picks frameworks by kind.

step-grade-target.evidence: "**Grade**: delegate the grading to fresh subagents... Each quotes the evidence first, then gives the verdict"
step-grade-target.why: Skill's own step produces a verdict per criterion on the target.

output-html-report.evidence: "**Report**: run make-report.py <spec> <grades> <out>.html, then open it or publish it as an Artifact."
output-html-report.why: A named step writes the HTML report from graded verdicts.

report-built-like-peers.evidence: scripts/make-report.py, assets/report.html and examples/card-skill/report.html all exist in the folder.
report-built-like-peers.why: Script plus template plus finished sample report present.

stops-at-rubric.evidence: Searched for a rubric-only ending; found Grade (report.md:26) and Report (report.md:27) steps after the Rubric step.
stops-at-rubric.why: Grade and Report steps exist, so the error is not committed.

verdict-fix-first.evidence:
make-report.py body() order: verdict section, then '

Fix first

', then '

Criteria

'; also "the page leads with the verdict and the fix list, highest tier first"
verdict-fix-first.why: Fix list precedes the per-criterion cards.

blended-number-first.evidence: "the page leads with the verdict and the fix list... and never with one blended number"; headline is per-tier counts ('N of M judged met').
blended-number-first.why: The layout forbids a blended headline number, so the error is not committed.

evidence-before-verdict.evidence: "Each quotes the evidence first, then gives the verdict; a verdict with no quote is not met."
evidence-before-verdict.why: Instruction order puts the quote before the verdict.

no-quote-not-met.evidence: Command: grep -n empty lib/rubric/grades.py -> line 42: out += [f"grades.grades.{k}.{f}: empty" for f in ("evidence", "why") if not g[f].strip()]; make-report.py:55-56 raises Refused on any problem.
no-quote-not-met.why: A script rejects grades whose evidence is empty.

judge-is-fresh.evidence: "delegate the grading to fresh subagents, never the context that wrote or revised the target, giving each only the target, the spec and the grades grammar."
judge-is-fresh.why: Fresh subagents get only target, spec and grammar.

rubric-frozen.evidence: "take the spec's sha... before any grading; it goes in the grades file, and make-report.py refuses grades whose sha differs... A change after grading makes a new version: save it under a new name"
rubric-frozen.why: Spec saved with a hash before grading; later change is a new version.

failed-card-fields.evidence:
card() in make-report.py renders criterion text, Evidence blockquote,

and

Fix:; Rules: "each failure carries its evidence, its reason and a fix"
failed-card-fields.why: All four fields shown on a failed card.

status-not-colour-alone.evidence: Command: grep -n '✓\|✗' scripts/make-report.py -> status_word returns "✓ Met", "✗ Not met", "✓ No error", "✗ Error found", "? Not judged"
status-not-colour-alone.why: Every status carries an icon and a word.

not-judged-section.evidence:
out.append('

Not judged

These could not be checked, each for the reason on its card. They are left out of the counts above...'
not-judged-section.why: Separate section with reason per card, excluded from counts shown (count text: 'N of M judged met, K not judged').

description-use-when.evidence: Command: sed -n 3p SKILL.md | grep -c '^description: Use when' -> 1; description length wc -c -> 269 (<=300).
description-use-when.why: Starts with Use when and is 269 characters.

routes-to-references.evidence: Route table rows: '| grade a target and show the result... | references/report.md |', author.md, calibrate.md, grade.md, repair.md
routes-to-references.why: Each case maps to one file under references/.

code-computes-in-scripts.evidence: "weights, scores, orders and agreement come from check-spec.py, score-spec.py and measure-judge.py, never from your own arithmetic; report cards come from make-report.py"
code-computes-in-scripts.why: Counting, scoring and page building are scripts in scripts/ with verb-noun names.

no-agents-or-tests-dirs.evidence: Command: find card -type d ( -name agents -o -name tests -o -name evals ) | wc -l -> 0

body-short-flat.evidence: Command: wc -l SKILL.md -> 37; grep -c for each of 8 references/**/*.md in SKILL.md -> 1 each.
body-short-flat.why: Under 500 lines and every reference markdown file is linked directly from SKILL.md.
